analysis: Price is attempting a breakout above the Value Area High at 83,950, driven almost entirely by derivative leverage rather than spot accumulation. key_risk: Lack of spot market follow-through leaves long perpetual positions susceptible to a cascade liquidation if price fails to hold VAH.
